sentences.text: Daniel Hajj Aboumrad, born in 1966, has served as chief executive officer of America Movil since 2000, and he has also been a director and member of the company's executive committee since that year.

sentences.quote: Daniel Hajj Aboumrad holds a Bachelor of Business Administration from Universidad Anahuac Mexico.

sentences.quote: In 1997, he was appointed Chief Executive Officer of Telcel and during his administration, America Movil was established as a result of the spin-off from Telmex.
sentences.text: He was named chief executive officer of Telcel in 1997, and during his tenure America Movil was created through the spin-off from Telmex.
Earlier in his career he led BIMEX, Dulces y Chocolates LUXUS, Artes Graficas Unidas, Galas de Mexico and Euskadi General Tire, the latter identified in company filings as Compania Hulera Euzkadi.

sentences.quote: Daniel Hajj is a member of the Board of Directors of Telmex, Carso Global Telecom and Grupo Carso.
sentences.text: He also sits on the boards of Telmex, Carso Global Telecom and Grupo Carso.

mgmt_bio.text: Daniel Hajj Aboumrad, born in 1966, has served as chief executive officer of America Movil since 2000, and he has also been a director and member of the company's executive committee since that year. He holds a bachelor's degree in business administration from Universidad Anahuac Mexico. He was named chief executive officer of Telcel in 1997, and during his tenure America Movil was created through the spin-off from Telmex. He also sits on the boards of Telmex, Carso Global Telecom and Grupo Carso.

sentences.quote: Daniel Hajj Aboumrad (CEO) has led America Movil since 2000, making him one of the longest-tenured telecom CEOs globally.
sentences.text: Daniel Hajj Aboumrad has run America Movil since 2000, one of the longest tenures in global telecom, during which the company grew from a Mexican mobile operator into Latin America's largest carrier.

Capital allocation is consistent and cash-funded: 2025 shareholder distributions of MXN 45 billion, including MXN 12 billion of buybacks, alongside a MXN 20 billion cut in net debt, with stated leverage discipline of 1.2x-1.5x net debt to EBITDA and bolt-on fiber deals inside existing markets rather than new-country expansion.

sentences.quote: He is the son-in-law of founder Carlos Slim Helu, which is central to understanding the company's governance.
sentences.text: Governance reflects family control: Hajj is the son-in-law of Carlos Slim Helu, whose family vehicles remain the controlling shareholders.

sentences.text: America Movil's customer growth is led by mobile postpaid and fixed broadband, with postpaid accesses up 9.1 percent and broadband accesses up 6.1 percent year on year in the second quarter of 2026.

Cost control is translating revenue into profit, as EBITDA grew faster than revenue in that quarter alongside a declining leverage ratio, after a first-quarter EBITDA margin of 40 percent and net income of 23.4 billion pesos, up 25 percent.
The balance sheet is deleveraging, with net debt down 31 billion pesos and leverage at 1.31 times net debt to EBITDA after leases and a stated target range of 1.2 to 1.5 times.

sentences.quote:
Free cash flow for H1 2026 was MXN 43 billion, more than double the prior year.
Capital expenditures for H1 2026 totaled MXN 48 billion; share buybacks MXN 4.6 billion.
sentences.text: Cash generation funds investment and shareholder returns, with first-half free cash flow of 43 billion pesos, capital expenditure of 48 billion pesos and buybacks of 4.6 billion pesos.
Scale and consolidation add optionality, including the WOW acquisition in Peru.
